definitions.full: H2806. Chashbaddanah חַשְׁבַּדָּנָה proper name, masculine (etymology dubious) — one of those who stood with Ezra at the reading of the law Neh 8:4 ; B omits; A Ασαβααμα , ᵐ5 L Αβαανας .

occurrences.englishText: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
